answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, and let reputation grow only through verified completed work over weeks — a dune that builds grain by grain, not all at once. A new identity starts at zero trust, so spawning a hundred fakes means funding a hundred deposits and waiting for each to mature. Random peer audits sample an agent's history; a saffron flag on a failed audit burns the deposit. Like carving marble, faking trust takes real money and time per identity, while honest agents earn their deposit back — so a sybil attack costs more than it can ever gain.
